description: `add --dry-run <path>` prints the `[projects.<name>]` block (and a chain for every role some available, non-interactive account's kind can serve, per Q14's eligibility rule) it would append to the config, and writes nothing — `_cmd_add_locked`'s own early return right after building `text`, before the config file is ever opened for append. One role (`scout`) with one eligible seat is enough to exercise the real chain-building path without needing every rule in its docstring (reviewer/oracle vendor-lead swaps) to fire. The chain is rendered under the role's current config key, not its retired one, because this preview must match what a following real `add` actually appends (and what `multiverse check` will accept afterward).

home.config_toml:
[accounts.seat-a]
kind = "codex"
short = "sa"
config_dir_var = "CODEX_HOME"
config_dir = "{{DIR:codex-home}}"
pool = "codex:a"

[projects.sandbox]
path = "{{PROJECT:sandbox}}"

[roles.explorer]
write_scope = "none"
effort = "low"
on_exhausted = "degrade"
skills = []

[roles.explorer.models]
codex = "gpt-test"
